home.whyGoodPriceTitle: Why are the prices so good?
home.whyGoodPriceText: Gulumen manufactures its own 3D printed products in Hungary and sells them directly – no reseller markup, no dropshipping, no middlemen. Order from a 3000+ product catalogue straight from the manufacturer.
home.loyaltyText: The loyalty programme is tied to your email address: after each successfully paid order over 50,000 Ft, a permanent discount is automatically applied to that email: +1% per qualifying order, up to 8% maximum. The loyalty discount cannot be combined with other coupons (e.g. first purchase or gift coupon).
home.aboutUsText: Gulumen is a Hungarian manufacturer of premium 3D printed home and functional products. You order directly from us: expert design, careful craftsmanship, custom production – not resale and not dropshipping.

sourcing.legal:
After placing the order, sourcing takes place through a dedicated sourcing channel.

If sourcing is successful, the product will be delivered within 7–14 business days.

If the product cannot be secured within the given price range, the order will be cancelled and the full amount will be refunded within 1–3 business days.

shipping.intro: We send our parcels with Posta, GLS, Foxpost and DPD.
shipping.freeShipping: Free shipping on orders over 25,000 HUF.
shipping.noPickup: Collection at our warehouse is not available.
shipping.notify: After your order we will email you about dispatch and the tracking link.
shipping.stockInfo: For in-stock items, dispatch takes place within 24–48 hours of payment being received.
shipping.sourcingNote: For order-to-source (limited availability) items, delivery may take longer. Those items are delivered after sourcing, typically within 7–14 working days.
shipping.mixedOrder: If an order contains both in-stock and order-to-source items, the full delivery follows the longer delivery time.
shipping.productPageNote: The product page always shows the expected delivery time for that product.

returns.intro: EU right of withdrawal applies (except: underwear, hygiene products).
returns.withdrawalParagraph: Under Government Decree 45/2014 (II.26.), the consumer has a 14-day right of withdrawal without giving a reason.
returns.costBullet: The customer pays the return shipping cost.
returns.refundBullet: For in-stock products, the refund is made within 14 days after the product is received.
returns.examinationRight: The customer is entitled to examine the product to the necessary extent.
returns.valueReductionBullet: If the product has depreciated due to use beyond its intended purpose, the amount to be refunded may be reduced proportionally.
returns.damagedRefundBullet: For damaged, worn, incomplete or tagless items, the refund may take into account the extent of depreciation.
returns.contact: To start a return, contact us (email or AI chat) and we will send you the necessary steps.
returns.sourcingIntro: Some products are not held in warehouse stock but are sourced from external partners after the order is placed.
returns.sourcingDelivery: For such products, the expected delivery time is 7–14 working days.
returns.sourcingCancel: If the buyer cancels a sourcing product after the sourcing process has started, the demonstrably incurred sourcing and logistics costs may be deducted from the amount to be refunded.
returns.sourcingDeduction: Deduction applies only to actually incurred and documented costs.
returns.sourcingFullRefund: If sourcing cannot be fulfilled on the advertised terms, the full amount will be refunded.
returns.legalIntro: This webshop operates in line with European Union consumer protection rules.
returns.legalLinkLabel: Detailed legal terms can be read here:

callUsDataProtection.title: Phone support – recording and transcription
callUsDataProtection.why: Calls may be recorded or automatically transcribed for quality and support purposes (with the caller’s consent).
callUsDataProtection.storage: Transcripts and recordings are kept only as long as necessary, in line with legal retention requirements.
callUsDataProtection.access: Access is limited to customer support and authorised staff to the extent needed for handling your case.
callUsDataProtection.deletion: To request deletion or restriction, email the address below with your request and reason; we will process it accordingly.

ai.greeting: Hi! How can I help? Ask about products, shipping or returns.
ai.payment: Payment is by card only: Cart → Checkout → Card payment → We send the order summary by email. Never share card details in chat – only on the secure checkout page.
ai.shipping: Posta, GLS, Foxpost, DPD. Free shipping over 25,000 HUF. In-stock items: dispatched within 24–48 hours after payment. Personal pickup not available.
ai.returns: Returns: the customer pays return shipping. For in-stock products, the refund is made within 14 days after the product is received. EU withdrawal rights apply (except underwear/hygiene).
ai.authenticity: We source items in small quantities from curated suppliers, so we can offer them at good prices. We present them transparently with photos and descriptions.
ai.register: Register and get a coupon for your first purchase. We'll email you about future deals and new arrivals.
ai.complaint: Please share your order ID and email, and briefly describe the issue (with a photo if possible). We'll create a ticket and our team will get back to you soon.
ai.handover: I'll pass this to a human agent. Please share your order ID and email, and we'll contact you shortly.
ai.productQuestion: Condition, size and price are on the product page. Dispatch: within 7–14 business days after sourcing; free shipping over 25,000 HUF. If you have more questions, just ask.
ai.noCard: Please never share card details, ID or passwords here. Payment is only on our secure checkout page.
ai.recommend: Which category interests you most? (Bags, Clothing, Accessories, Electronics) I can suggest 3–5 products.
ai.thanks: Thanks! If you have more questions, just ask.
ai.default: You can ask about products, shipping (Posta, GLS, Foxpost, DPD; free over 25,000 HUF), returns or payment. How can I help?
ai.title: Gulumen – Help
ai.cta: Got a question? I can help!
ai.escalateNote: ↑ Case forwarded to a human agent.
